attack_techniques: Credentials from Password Stores: Cloud Secrets Management Stores (T1555.006)
attackers_goals: Collect secrets from the cloud environment.
description: An identity dumped multiple secrets from the project, considerably more than usual. This may indicate an attacker's attempt to dump sensitive information from the cloud environment.
investigative_actions: Check the accessed secrets' designation. Verify that the identity did not dump any sensitive information that it shouldn't.
name: Suspicious secrets dump activity
